sourceInterpretation.eq003: Both exact approved sentences assert a confirmed restriction on using stairs and attribute route selection to the engine. Captured profile versions 3 and 4 have canUseStairs=false with confirmation timestamps, and corresponding independent candidate-engine reevaluations produce valid matching non-stair routes. No destination, direction change, demographic inference, or support acceptance/arrival is asserted by the supplement.
sourceInterpretation.eq002: Its approved supplement is conditional, but its document requires a real direction-change update. This stairs history shows heading/slew 0 throughout and a single initial pose event, with profile updates at fixed virtual 1000 ms. No direction change is established or invented; EQ-002 is excluded before ranking/model and is absent from accepted citations. No previous-route invalidation is claimed.
sourceInterpretation.eq001: The additional candidate is body-applicable to the observed equipment exposure, known position and valid constrained route. It is an option in the prompt but EQ-003 is selected in both measured invocations. Source004 does not impose the original extra COMMON-only whitelist.
